claims.evidence: Witness report shows partial brand text on the tank (“Kawasa…”) but no clear, readable “ZZR” model/variant identification in the shown photos.
No photo/video evidence of the bike starting, running, or being tested; only instrument cluster/controls and wheel/brake area are shown.
No documentation (receipt/registration) or odometer/mileage clarity shown to support the timeline.
Only a front wheel/disc rotor area is partially visible; no clear view of brake pads/rotor wear, rear brake, or a gear test.
Photos do not provide comprehensive body/frame coverage to confirm rust absence.
No close-ups/serials or comparison evidence shown to confirm originality of major components.
This is a personal reason; no evidence in the photos.

risks.risk: Exact model/variant is unclear (ZZR not confirmed), which affects market value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model badge/engine number/VIN plate and the full tank/side fairing text showing “ZZR” (or equivalent exact variant).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unconfirmed Kawasaki sport bike with unknown variant (worst-case valuation for mismatch/parts uncertainty).

risks.risk: Engine condition and whether it starts/runs smoothly is unknown; instrument cluster alone doesn’t confirm mechanical health.
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start, idle, and a brief throttle test (and gear engagement from 1st to top gear).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven running/unknown mechanical condition (worst-case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Mileage/odometer reading is not readable; high mileage can materially reduce value.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit close-up photo of the odometer/mileage display showing the digits.

risks.risk: Brake condition beyond the visible front disc is unknown (rear brake, pad thickness, rotor wear).
risks.proof: Photos of both front and rear brake calipers/pads and rotor thickness/wear marks; plus a video showing braking at low speed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes not fully verified (worst-case: pads/rotor service may be needed).

risks.risk: Tyre tread and overall tyre condition are not shown for both tyres; tyres are a common cost risk.
risks.proof: Clear photos of both tyres (front and rear) showing tread depth and sidewall condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may be worn (worst-case: replacement soon).

risks.risk: Electricals/charging system (headlamp, indicators, horn, battery health) are not verified.
risks.proof: Video showing ignition on with headlamp, indicators, horn, and charging/voltage reading (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals unverified (worst-case: battery/charging or bulbs may need work).

risks.risk: Body/frame condition (scratches, dents, rust in unseen areas) and accident history are not fully visible.
risks.proof: Full side, front, rear, and under-fairing photos in good light; close-ups of any damage points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetic/structural condition unknown (worst-case: possible repairs).

risks.risk: Ownership/documents status is not shown; Abuja buyers need proof to avoid legal/transfer issues.
risks.proof: Photos of ownership documents (receipt/transfer papers/registration) and any VIN/engine number matching documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documents not verified (worst-case: transfer risk).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact model/variant marking confirming “ZZR” (badge/side fairing/model plate).
Clear photo of engine number and VIN/serial plate (and matching documents).
Video of cold start, idle, and a short ride test showing smooth gear changes.
Clear odometer/mileage close-up with readable digits.
Photos of front and rear brake pads/rotors (wear condition) and a low-speed braking video.
Photos of both tyres (front and rear) showing tread and sidewall condition.
Video showing all electricals: headlamp (high/low), indicators, horn, and a charging/battery check if possible.
Photos of ownership/transfer documents required for Abuja.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Kawasaki motorcycle, but the exact “ZZR” variant and critical value drivers (running condition, mileage, brake/tyre/electricals, and documents) are not verifiable from the shown images. Without at least a running/odometer/model confirmation, any worst-case pricing would be too speculative.
